title: Agentic Society: Merging skeleton from real world and texture from Large Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-generated personas using the Big Five personality test and comparing the simulated trait distributions across age groups with real-world population statistics to identify an artificial skew toward socially positive or 'well-behaved' traits (e.g., abnormally high conscientiousness and agreeableness, and low neuroticism).
